|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Rebel Assault]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Assault (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 6, file created 2 August 2024: “When drawn for weapon or battle destiny, destiny +1 for each of your battlegrounds on table (limit +4). If you have deployed four battlegrounds, choose: Shuffle this card into your Force pile. OR During battle, add 2 to your total power.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Rebel Assault]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Rebel Assault]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Rebel Assault”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[S-foils]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
